summary: Iteration 117: Badge Showcase on Public User Profiles & Leaderboard - All new features tested and working. Backend APIs pass 15/16 tests (1 minor data inconsistency). Frontend UI components render correctly.

minor.issue: Leaderboard contains user_id (69cf7746a034567d4b91e86b) that doesn't exist in users collection - orphaned referral data

critical_code_review_comments: BADGE_ICONS in ReferralLeaderboard.jsx doesn't include 'free' badge - this is intentional design (free users don't show badge pill)
PublicProfile correctly handles 'Profile not found' state for invalid user_ids
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 117 tested Badge Showcase + Public Profiles. Backend APIs working: GET /api/referral/leaderboard (returns entries with user_id and badge fields), GET /api/referral/profile/{user_id} (returns public profile with badge, role, founding_member, beta_access, total_referrals, leaderboard_rank, member_since), GET /api/referral/profile/{invalid_id} (returns 404). Frontend: Leaderboard renders with badge pills for non-free users, names are clickable and open PublicProfile modal, modal shows avatar, masked name, badge, stats, badges earned section. Note: Current leaderboard has 1 entry with badge='free' (no badge pill shown by design) and orphaned user_id that returns 'Profile not found'.

verified_features.GET /api/referral/leaderboard: PASS - Returns leaderboard array with user_id and badge fields, total_participants count
verified_features.GET /api/referral/profile/{valid_user_id: PASS - Returns user_id, name (masked), badge, role, founding_member, beta_access, subscription_status, total_referrals, leaderboard_rank, member_since
verified_features.Admin user profile badge: PASS - Admin user (69d8c194e0cdcd6613a00891) has badge='creator' and role='admin'
verified_features.Badge priority logic: PASS - _get_badge_type correctly implements creator > founding > beta > pro > free
verified_features.Leaderboard renders on dashboard: PASS - Top Referrers section visible with participant count
verified_features.Leaderboard names are clickable: PASS - Names have data-testid and open PublicProfile modal on click
verified_features.PublicProfile modal opens: PASS - Modal opens when leaderboard name is clicked
verified_features.PublicProfile 'Profile not found' state: PASS - Shows 'Profile not found' with Close button for invalid users
verified_features.PublicProfile close button: PASS - Close button works and dismisses modal
verified_features.Dashboard renders: PASS - All sections visible including leaderboard

notes: The only leaderboard entry has badge='free' which doesn't show a badge pill (by design - BADGE_ICONS only includes creator, founding, beta, pro). The user_id in the leaderboard (69cf7746a034567d4b91e86b) is orphaned data - the user no longer exists in the users collection, so clicking on it shows 'Profile not found'. This is a data inconsistency issue, not a code bug.
